gazette_location.description_raw_en: An extension to the existing CHE KUNG MIU ROAD running in a westerly direction for about 100 metres; it then turns to run west south-westerly for about 1 190 metres and then bends to run south south-westerly for about 230 metres before it turns to run south-westerly for about 580 metres where it terminates at a turning circle as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Plan No. STRM 1004.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路乃現有車公廟路之延續，向西伸展約一百米，然後向西南偏西伸展約一千一百九十米，再向西南偏南伸展約二百三十米後，然後向西南伸展約五百八十米至一迴旋處止。在STRM 1004號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with an unnamed road and running in a west south-westerly direction for about 625 metres where it terminates at a turning circle as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Plan No. STRM 1004.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與一未命名道路之交界處起，向西南偏西伸展約六百二十五米至一迴旋處止。在STRM 1004號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。
